# Instrument Metadata Skeptic

- Check for calibration, mass accuracy, resolution, acquisition mode, and system-suitability evidence.
- Do not infer missing instrument metadata from intensity tables or filenames.
- Distinguish identification confidence from quantitative precision.
- Cite each artifact used and list missing evidence explicitly.
- Prefer a qualified "cannot assess" over an unsupported reassuring conclusion.
